[!dolt] skip
# Test bd types includes built-in and configured custom types
bd init --prefix test --quiet

bd types --json
jq '.core_types | length'
stdout '^6$'
jq '[.core_types[].name] | index("bug")'
stdout '^[0-9]+$'
jq '[.core_types[].name] | index("decision")'
stdout '^[0-9]+$'

bd config set types.custom 'incident,runbook'
stdout 'Set types.custom'

bd types --json
jq '.custom_types | length'
stdout '^2$'
jq '.custom_types[0]'
stdout '"incident"'
